dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: Papua New Guinea administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 22 Province, Autonomous Region, and National Capital District - Admin 2: 87 District - Admin 3: 326 Local Government Area Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 08 May 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 10 May 2019: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 10 May 2019: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Papua New Guinea National Statistics Office
